title: LogToPersona: New Benchmark and Efficient Persona Prediction through Semantic Log Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2611.33510v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Detailed knowledge of a user's persona is valuable for personalizing generative AI models and agents, yet such details are difficult to obtain and change over time. We address the task of inferring persona attributes from a single day of mobile activity logs. No suitable publicly available benchmark exists for this task, so we introduce a synthetic benchmark of 1,600 persona-log pairs. We target on-device inference so that raw logs never leave the phone, which makes memory rather than speed the limiting constraint: a day of activity yields roughly 30K tokens, whose key-value cache alone exceeds the INT4 weights of a 4B-parameter model. We therefore propose a log filtering method that retains only behaviorally distinct entries. Filtering reduces the memory footprint by up to 39% across nine models from four families and more than halves prefill time, while maintaining or improving prediction quality. translated_title: LogToPersona：新基准与基于语义日志过滤的高效人格预测
translated_abstract: 详细了解用户的人格画像对于个性化生成式AI模型和智能体非常有价值，然而这些细节难以获取且会随时间变化。我们研究从单日移动设备活动日志中推断人格属性的任务。目前没有合适的公开可用基准，因此我们引入了一个包含1,600个人格-日志对的合成基准。我们的目标是端侧（设备上）推理，使原始日志永远不会离开手机，这使得内存而非速度成为限制性约束：一天的活动会产生约30K个token，其键值缓存本身就超过了40亿参数模型的INT4权重大小。因此，我们提出了一种日志过滤方法，仅保留行为上具有区分性的条目。过滤使来自四个模型家族的九个模型的内存占用最多降低39%，并将预填充时间缩短一半以上，同时保持或提高预测质量。对于Qwen3-4B，它减少了2.5GB的内存占用。
tldr: 本文提出了LogToPersona任务及包含1600个人格-日志对的合成基准，通过语义日志过滤方法在端侧设备上实现高效的用户人格属性预测，内存占用最多降低39%且预填充时间减半以上。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LogToPersona, a new task and synthetic benchmark of 1,600 persona-log pairs, along with a semantic log filtering method that enables efficient on-device persona prediction by reducing memory footprint by up to 39% and more than halving prefill time while maintaining prediction quality.
